spells.name: Explobomb
spells.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Fire damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Explobombs present on the field.

spells.name: Grenado
spells.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Air damage and remove MP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -1 MP
• Combo V to IX: -2 MP
• Combo X to XV: -3 MP
• Wall of Air: -2 MP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Grenados present on the field.

spells.name: Water Bomb
spells.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Water damage and remove AP depending on its Combo in an area of effect when it explodes.
• Combo I to IV: -0 AP
• Combo V to IX: -1 AP
• Combo X to XV: -2 AP

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The wall of Water Bombs only removes AP from entities that move through it or start their turn inside it.
• Wall of Water: -2 AP

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Water Bombs present on the field.

spells.name: Seismobomb
spells.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Earth damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

The spell's AP cost increases by 1 for each of the caster's Seismobombs present on the field.

spells.name: Resilient Seismobomb
spells.description:
Places a Bomb that can inflict Earth damage in an area of effect when it explodes.

On a target: applies the Bomb's effects in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.
If the target is one of their Bombs: also adds 1 Combo to the Bomb and makes it explode.

spells.name: Detonator
spells.description:
Adds 1 Combo to one of the caster's Bombs and makes it explode.
Gives 1 AP back to the caster before the explosion.

spells.name: Fuze
spells.description:
Makes one of the caster's Bombs explode.
Gives 3 AP back to the caster before the explosion.

spells.name: Pulsar
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

spells.name: Shrapnel
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also reduces enemies' AP in an area of effect around the caster's Bombs in the area of effect.

spells.name: Carbine
spells.description: Inflicts Air damage on enemies and repels targets outwards in an area of effect.

spells.name: Obliteration
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage.
Damage increases with each Seismobomb or Sticky Bomb explosion.

On one of the caster's Bombs: adds Combos for each Seismobomb or Sticky Bomb explosion.

The effects are removed after the spell has been used.

spells.name: Kickback
spells.description:
Applies a shield on the caster's Bombs and pushes them out from the centre in an area of effect.
The closer the spell is cast to one of the caster's Bombs, the more it is pushed.

Pushes other entities one cell only.
Does not affect the caster.

spells.name: Ruse
spells.description:
Moves the caster closer to the target.
If the target is one of the caster's Bombs, also applies a shield.

spells.name: Stolen Goods
spells.description: Inflicts Water damage on enemies and attracts the target.

spells.name: Weigh Down
spells.description:
Inflicts Fire damage on enemies.

On one of the caster's elemental Bombs: inflicts Fire damage on enemies between two elemental Bombs in the same row and adds 1 Combo to these Bombs.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn.

spells.name: Bombard
spells.description: Inflicts Earth damage on enemies and repels the targets in an area of effect.

spells.name: Machine Gun
spells.description: Inflicts Air damage and removes MP.

spells.name: Magnet
spells.description:
Draws the caster's Bombs toward the centre and adds 1 Combo to them in an area of effect.
The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn and only if the Bombs are moved.

Attracts other entities one cell only.
Does not affect the caster.

spells.name: Crossing
spells.description:
Draws the caster's Bombs to the centre and adds 1 Combo to them in an area of effect.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn and only if the Bombs are moved.

spells.name: Dirty Trick
spells.description:
Adds 1 Combo to one of the caster's Bombs, switches positions with it and applies the Gravity to it.
The effects are only applied if the position switch can occur.

On an ally: only switches places with the target.

spells.name: Walking Bomb
spells.description:
Summons a controllable Bomb that can copy the element and some of the Combo of a caster's Bomb.

It is destroyed at the end of its second turn if it has not obtained an element.

spells.name: Boombot
spells.description:
Summons a controllable robot that can move or trigger the caster's Bombs.
The robot is destroyed at the end of its turn.

spells.name: Megabomb
spells.description:
Summons a controllable Megabomb that can inflict Neutral Damage and devour Bombs to increase its damage.

When destroyed, it explodes and adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs and causes them to explode in a 2-cell circle.

spells.name: Boomerang Daggers
spells.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Air damage in an area of effect.

spells.name: Blunderbuss
spells.description: Erodes the targets and inflicts Water damage in an area of effect.

spells.name: Roguery
spells.description:
Applies a shield on all the caster's Bombs.

Creates the caster's illusions and teleports the caster to the targeted cell.
Ends the caster's current turn.

spells.name: Strategy
spells.description:
Teleports one of the caster's Bombs to its previous position and applies a shield to it.
The shield is only applied if the teleportation can occur.

spells.name: Extraction
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element.
The health steal is reduced by half on allies.

spells.name: Cadence
spells.description:
Inflicts Air damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also reduces enemies' MP in an area of effect around the caster's Bombs in the area of effect.

spells.name: Remission
spells.description:
Applies the Remission state on the target:
• Repels attackers if the target suffers close-combat damage.

If cast on one of the caster's Bombs: reduces long-range damage suffered.

spells.name: Bunker
spells.description:
Makes one of the caster's bombs Invulnerable and adds 1 Combo to it.

The effects are transferred to the Bomb produced by a Walking Bomb.

spells.name: Musket
spells.description:
Inflicts Earth damage on enemies in an area of effect.
Also adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs in an area of effect.

The Combo is only applied once per Bomb per turn.

spells.name: Shot Pellets
spells.description:
Steals HP in the Fire element in an area of effect.
The health steal is reduced by half on allies.

Does not affect the caster.

spells.name: Powder
spells.description:
Makes one of the caster's Bombs Unmovable.
Adds 2 Combo to the Bomb:
• By causing it to explode if it is destroyed.
• By removing the spell's effects if it is cast on another Bomb.

The effects are removed if the Bomb is triggered by an explosion effect.

spells.name: Sticky Bomb
spells.description:
Places a sticky bomb on the target.
On a free cell: places a trap that puts a Sticky Bomb on the entity that triggers it or makes one of the caster's Bombs explode.

The Bomb may be activated by activation spells or bomb explosions.
When activated, it inflicts damage in the caster's best element and makes the caster's Bombs explode in an area of effect.

A Sticky Bomb cannot be applied to an Elemental Bomb.

spells.name: Deception
spells.description:
Inflicts Water damage and removes AP in the area of effect.
Does not affect the caster.

On the caster's Bombs: teleports them symmetrically in relation to the centre of the area of effect.

spells.name: Arquebus
spells.description: Reduces the duration of effects on the target and inflicts Earth damage on enemies.

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.description: Reduces the caster's maximum Vitality to temporarily add 3 Combos to their Bombs.

spells.name: Magnetic Trap
spells.description: Places a single-cell trap that attracts targets, adds 1 Combo to the caster's Bombs and makes them explode in an area of effect.

spells.name: Kaboom
spells.description:
Applies the Kaboom state to allies in an area of effect.

On the caster's Elemental Bombs: adds 1 Combo.

spells.name: Imposture
spells.description:
Switches places with the target and applies the Kaboom state to the caster.
• On an ally: also applies the state to them.
• On one of the caster's Elemental Bombs: adds 1 Combo to the Bomb.
Applies the Imposture state to the caster and the targeted ally on the next turn, which prevents the Kaboom state from being applied.

The Combo and the Kaboom state are only applied if the position switch can occur.
